description: Convert dates between Gregorian and Hijri (named variants), Hebrew, Persian, Ethiopian; Western and Orthodox Easter — Converts a Gregorian date (or a Hebrew, Persian, Ethiopian or Hijri date) to the other calendars via the runtime's ICU, always naming the Hijri variant (Umm al-Qura, tabular civil, tabular astronomical-epoch, ICU astronomical) and flagging when variants disagree on the day; with mode easter, returns Western (Gregorian computus) and Orthodox (Julian computus, with its Gregorian equivalent) Easter a

date.description: convert: Gregorian date. Exactly one of date or from.

feasts.description: easter: also list Ash Wednesday, Good Friday, Ascension, Pentecost and other moveable feasts.

month.description: Numeric month. Hebrew follows ICU: Tishri=1; leap years have Adar I=6, Adar II=7, Nisan=8 ... Elul=13; common years have Adar=6, Nisan=7 ... Elul=12.

to.description: Calendars to convert into; hijri-all returns Umm al-Qura, tabular civil and ICU astronomical (add islamic-tbla explicitly; it differs from civil by its epoch) and fails when they disagree. Default: all non-Hijri plus hijri-all.

name: calendar-convert
